title: Land Title Registry
summary: Claim the map cell by cell, in tiers. Every cell climbs a ladder — Wilderness, Trail, Rampart, Deed — and the engine itself enforces what you may build where, so manual placement, blueprints and construction bots all obey it. Buy rights with land points earned from research, sell them back for a refund, and expand outward from territory you already hold. Runs standalone in single-player or multiplayer, with optional Multi-Team Support integration.
